fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' {{tip|channels}} for 2 seconds, signaling '''{{ci|Valor}}''' to pair up. Upon completion, he picks her up and they unite, increasing her {{sti|ms|{{as|{{tt|'''total''' movement speed|Increases base movement as well as bonus movement speed}}}}}}, granting her {{tip|ghosted|ghosting}}, and allowing her to cast ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''. ''Behind Enemy Lines'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel.
fields.description2: Taking damage from non-{{tip|minions}} while ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is active or while '''Quinn''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}} the ability causes her to lose the {{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds. Becoming {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}} ends ''Behind Enemy Lines'' immediately and puts it on {{sti|cooldown}} without performing ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''.
fields.description3: Once ''Behind Enemy Lines'' has been learned, [[death|respawning]] or entering {{tt|any|see notes}} [[Spawn|summoning platform]] will spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' instantly.
fields.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Quinn''' cancels the channel, placing ''Behind Enemy Lines'' on cooldown.
fields.notes:
* Taking damage from non-{{tip|minions}} removes the bonus movement speed buff temporarily by suppressing it with the status effect of a {{tip|slow}}.
** This slow is not affected by {{tip|slow resist}} or {{tip|slow immunity}}, but it can be {{tip|cleanse|cleansed}}.
** While the slow is in effect, ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is not considered to grant increased {{as|movement speed}} for the purpose of {{ri|Celerity}}.
* ''Behind Enemy Lines'' does not refund its {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} if the channel was canceled via recast.
** The only exception is if '''Quinn's''' {{as|mana}} falls below the {{as|mana cost}}, in which case she is granted enough {{as|mana}} back (the equal amount needed) to be able to cast ''Behind Enemy Lines'' again.
* [[death|Respawning]] or returning to the [[Spawn|summoning platform]] will not spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' if ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is on cooldown.
* If '''{{ci|Valor}}''' is spawned by [[death|respawning]] or returning to the [[Spawn|summoning platform]], {{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}} will be disabled from being manually cast for {{fd|2.5}} seconds upon uniting. However, it will still automatically activate upon declaring a {{tip|basic attack}} or casting {{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}} or {{ai|Vault|Quinn}}.
* ''Behind Enemy Lines'' ends immediately without {{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}} being cast if she enters or is inside the enemy [[fountain]]. The ability will go on full {{sti|cooldown}}.
** '''Quinn''' will also spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' when entering the enemy fountain.{{bug}}
* Self or allied applied {{tip|immobilize|immobilizations}} such as {{ui|Blast Cone}}, {{ai|Tempered Fate|Bard}}, and {{ii|Zhonya's Hourglass}} also count for ending ''Behind Enemy Lines''.

** ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is not a [[Channel#Movement Channels|movement channel]], and so will not be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|root}} and {{tip|ground}}.
